comment: Pinned build inputs for the Linux/Arc path. scripts/fetch_deps.py stages each into work/ and refuses any .deb whose SHA-256, or checkout whose commit, differs from the value here. A deb is fetched at its exact version with apt, so the host's own mirror is used and the hash guards against a mirror serving different bytes. Host packages (a C compiler, glslangValidator, the Vulkan loader) are declared in config/system-deps.yaml instead; language dependencies live in pyproject.toml and uv.lock. This file is only what is downloaded.
